verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents general multi-user admin controls, permissions, and embedded chat widgets. It contains nothing on gating inbound messages from messaging surfaces, such as sender allowlists, DM policies, or mention gating. Workspace user permissions are an adjacent control, not the requested capability, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, inbound messages are gated — sender allowlists, DM policies, mention gating — so only people I approve can drive my assistant
